links.outcome: Local retrospective validation of auto-contours against manual contours: usability, geometric agreement, dosimetric impact
links.effect: 76.1% of auto-contours clinically usable (score ≥3); DSC >0.8 in 54.8%, MDA <2.5 mm in 71.5%, max HD <12.5 mm in 50%; 88.1% of organs within ±5% dose-volume difference.
links.quote: Overall, 76.1% of auto-contours were qualitatively judged to be clinically usable (score ≥3).

links.outcome: Variation in auto-contouring performance across anatomical sites and organs
links.effect: Performance showed organ-dependent variability across six anatomical sites, with 8/29 structures being major geometric outliers.
links.quote: The SYNAPSE Radiotherapy system showed high overall clinical usability with organ-dependent variability.

unlisted_practices: Organ-specific quality assurance policy for auto-contouring
Plan-level dosimetric impact assessment of AI auto-contours

screen.reason: Retrospective multi-metric validation (geometric, qualitative usability by radiation oncologists, and dosimetric impact) of a commercial deep learning auto-contouring system across six anatomical sites.
